title: Heaven Burns Red Game's Main Story Heads to Final Chapter
content: The staff for Jun Maeda 's ( Kanon , Air , Clannad , Angel Beats! ) Heaven Burns Red game announced the start of its 4.5th anniversary campaign on Sunday, which includes updates, and marks the beginning of the final chapter of the game's main story.
author: ANN

title: My Boy, Gene Bride Author Hitomi Takano Launches New Manga
content: Manga creator Hitomi Takano launched a new manga titled Tomodachi kara de mo Ii desu ka ( Can we start as friends? ) on Shinchosha 's Comic Bunch Kai web manga magazine, on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Fate/Grand Order: Fujimaru Ritsuka wa Wakaranai Anime Shorts Get 4th Season on August 7
content: The "Yūshikisha Himitsu Kaigō ~Chaldea Gakuensai~" stage at the FGO Fes. 2026 event on Sunday announced that the Fate/Grand Order: Fujimaru Ritsuka wa Wakaranai (Fate/Grand Order: Ritsuka Fujimaru Doesn't Get It) anime shorts will get a fourth season, which will launch on August 7 within the "Club Chaldea FGO Radio…
author: ANN

title: My Hero Academia Releases Eri's Version of "Hero too" Song Following New Anime Short
content: My Hero Academia has released “Hero too -10th Anniversary version-,” performed by Eri across major music streaming platforms following the premiere of the franchise’s new anniversary anime short , I am a hero too . Singer Myka Morton performs the vocals for Eri’s version featured in the anniversary short.
author: Anime Corner

title: Yamayade's Can You Kiss Me First? BL Manga Gets Live-Action Series This Fall
content: Fuji TV announced on Monday that it is producing a live-action series adaptation of Yamayade 's Can You Kiss Me First? ( Omae no Hou kara Kiss Shitekure yo ) boys' love manga that will air on Fuji TV this fall, and will also stream on Fuji TV On Demand .
author: ANN

title: 'Draw This, Then Die!' Anime Casts Anna Nagase
content: The official website for the television anime of Minoru Toyoda 's Draw This, Then Die! ( Kore Kaite Shine ) manga announced on Monday that Anna Nagase will join the anime's cast as Loups Garous (a pen name), a manga creator that Yasumi meets at Comitia.
author: ANN

title: Suzu Ōmi's The Girl Past the Filters Manga Ends on August 25
content: The September issue of Coamix 's Monthly Comic Zenon magazine announced on July 24 that Suzu Ōmi 's The Girl Past the Filters ( Filter Goshi no Kanojo ) manga will end in the magazine's next issue on August 25. Yen Press licensed the manga and published the manga's second compiled book volume in English on May 26.
author: ANN

title: To Love-Ru Manga Gets New 1-Shot for 20th Anniversary
content: This year's 35th issue of Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine announced on July 27 that Kentarō Yabuki and Saki Hasemi 's To Love Ru manga will get a new 25-page one-shot story in the Jump Giga seasonal magazine to celebrate the series' 20th anniversary.
author: ANN

title: Kochikame Manga Gets New 1-Shot Commemorating 50th Anniversary
content: This year's 36th issue of Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump Magazine published a new one-shot story for Osamu Akimoto 's Kochikame manga to celebrate the series' 50th anniversary on Monday.
author: ANN

title: Masami Yūki Draws 2nd New Patlabor 1-Shot Manga
content: This year's combined 36th and 37th issue of Shogakukan 's Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine announced on Monday that Masami Yūki will publish a second new one-shot story for the Patlabor franchise in the magazine's next issue on August 17.
author: ANN
